_readme: mediacenter.html loads this file at startup; if it is missing or invalid the built-in defaults are used.
Add your own videos here. platform: youtube | odysee | vimeo | dailymotion | direct | local
For youtube use the 11 character video id, for odysee use 'claim-id' or '@channel/claim-id'.
Set demo:true to play the built-in procedural demo tape instead of embedding a real video.
Change the 'channels' array to point at your real profiles.
